verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google's spend is being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 33 leads at an average cost of $113.90 per lead — all of them from Meta, where Facebook and Instagram ads are the only channel currently converting. Google Ads spent $2,004 over the same window and recorded zero leads; this traces to a confirmed conversion-tracking misconfiguration, not campaign underperformance, and the fix is in progress. On Meta, cost per lead rose 23% week-over-week and Instagram reach dropped sharply, signalling creative fatigue, so ad creative is being refreshed this week to stabilize volume. Your Google Business Profile continued to generate organic activity — 27 calls and 62 direction requests this period — showing steady local demand. Once Google Ads tracking is corrected, you should see conversions begin to register there and cost per lead across both channels improve.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads conversion tracking is misconfigured, causing $2,004 in spend to show zero leads this period.
watch_item.fix: The conversion action and tracking pixel are being corrected now; Google Ads results will begin reporting accurately once the fix is confirmed live.
